news.title: Researchers Detail iPhone Flaw That Let Apps Record Audio Despite Denied Microphone Permission
news.detail: A now-patched flaw in Apple's audio service let apps on iPhones and iPads record audio even after the user tapped "Don't Allow" on the microphone prompt. The first security updates with the fix came out on August 17. Neither Apple nor the…
